title: ETH AI Center Postdoctoral Fellowships
about: The ETH AI Center invites applications for its 2027 Postdoctoral Fellowships in interdisciplinary AI research. Applicants must hold a PhD or finish it before the start; at least two references are required, and a postdoc selection symposium is held in January 2027.
requirements: PhD held at the submission deadline or completed at least three months before the start

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: "Interdisciplinary artificial intelligence research" (record field) → "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis."

"Interdisciplinary artificial intelligence research" (record field) → "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management."
